wake.description: a promise to come back to something at a time
wake.$comment: There is no apply patch: a rule's produce already writes the entity it matched. If a wake needs to patch its target without code, the fix is a rule that names a target.

at.description: when it is next due; absent once a one-shot has fired and a recurrence has ended

target.description: what the wake is about — the entity carrying it when absent

note.description: a line for whoever is woken: why you asked to be

every.description: how it recurs: a duration (30m, 2h, 1d), five cron fields (0 9 * * 1-5), or @hourly/@daily/@weekly/@monthly; cron may end with an IANA zone (0 9 * * 1-5 America/New_York), otherwise UTC

fired.description: when a wake last went off
